classification.reason: KI-122 in known_issues.md documents this exact scenario (bulk task move drops custom field values when the destination board lacks a matching field) as expected, non-bug behavior, so the KB clearly answers the customer's question.

draft.reply: {"reply": "Thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the confusing experience. What you're seeing is expected behavior tied to a known issue (KI-122): when tasks are bulk-moved to a different board, custom field values are dropped if the destination board doesn't already have a matching custom field. In this case, since the destination board didn't have a 'Priority Score' field set up, that data was not carried over during the move. To avoid this on future bulk moves, we'd recommend confirming that the destination board has a matching custom field (same name/type) configured before moving tasks over. If you'd like, you can recreate the 'Priority Score' field on the new board and re-enter the values manually. Let us know if you have any other questions!", "citations": ["known_issues.md#KI-122"]}

verification.notes: Citation KI-122 is accurate and fully supports the claim; reply stays within documented policy, makes no refund/account commitments, and is professionally toned.
